title: Izge: final product-led composition
question: The dark direction is confirmed. Keep the original layout, or use one of these two actual-component-informed arrangements. Images remain layout references; source documents and UI behavior must follow the app.

options.label: Keep the selected composition
options.viewport: Headline, prominent finding and adjacent team exchange.
options.risk: Invented integrations, counts and metadata in the image will be removed.

options.label: Daily review in focus
options.thesis: The app's cited answer and expandable evidence lead.
options.viewport: Large review answer, sources and adjacent team handover.
options.risk: Image-invented PDF pagination becomes the app's real source modal.

options.label: Follow the evidence
options.thesis: A guided sequence moves from review to sources to team chat.
options.viewport: Source evidence takes the stage, with cited finding and team handover.
options.risk: Generated combined document will be replaced with separate real source records.
